verses.text: kawwin liyal yawma nasran hazza mawlaayaa
wal takshifil hujba hannii hab liyal aayaa
tawwaabu lighfir zunuubii wamhu kulla laghan
hanni wa kun liya fii dunyaa wa ukhraayaa
bikawnikal waahidal qahhaara rud liya yaa
rabbil hidaa waltukhallid fiika bushraa yaa
antal ilaahul lazii tuhlii wa tarfahu man
qad shi-tahu faltutayyib fiika mah-yaa yaa
lakas samaa wal araadii wal hawaa-u mahan
qinii azal kulli wal tukhlid mazaayaa yaa
lakas salaatiinu turran wal muluuku kazaa
atbaa huhum liya rudhum qabla luq-yaa yaa
hab lii talaazuma maa tardaahu min hamalin
wa min maqaalin wa haqdin hinda  maghnaa yaa
lakal baraayaa jamiihan wal bilaa dufakun
lii yaa ilaahiya fii daarii wa tuubaa yaa
unsur janaabii wa hisnii lii atib humurii
bimaa tuhibbu wa ahsin fiika taqwaa yaa
ghaniitu bil waahidil qahhaari han zumarin
wa kaana lii wa nafaa faqri wa balwaa yaa
lahu tawajjahtu zaa shukrin lahu abadan
wa artajii minhu maa lam yahwi sharwaa yaa
bikawnikal qaadiral qahhaara muqtadiran
arjuu talaazuma maa ahwaa bimanjaa yaa
naajaytuhu raajiyan an laa yukhayyibanii
wa an yuwajjiha lii maa faaqa man jaayaa
nawaytu irdaa-ahu irdaa-a man salahuu
bahdan siraa fii ilaa ahlii wa suknaa yaa
antal qadiirul lazii arjuu biqudratihi
hawzis siyaadata zidnii bahda husnaa yaa
nabazsu maa kaana hindii suq bikawnika lii
dunyaa wa ukhral lazii tardaa birughbaa yaa
atil mukuusii bitaahaatin mukhallasatin
waktub biqahrika yaa rabbii ghulubba yaa
wajjih bihizzika lii hizzan akuunu bihi
habdan haziizan wa khallid hanka hutbaa yaa
rabbaytanii bil hidaa rud lil jamiiha wa qud
nii lil a-hibbati wahmad rabbi mas-haa yaa
suq sarmadan liya maa faaqal munaa karaman
wajhal kitaabaka fid daarayni marhaa yaa
lii suq dawaaman ku-uusal qawmi tarwiyatan
waltasqinii waltuhazzim rabbi suq-yaa yaa
yaa zaal baqaa-il lazii abqayta lii humurii
habdan khadiiman sahiidan wahmi bugh-yaa yaa
ilayka wajjahtu wajhii daahiyan malikii
falis tajib karaman yaa rabbi dahwaa yaa
najjaytanii faltazidnii rabbi tanjiyatan
wal tahminii wahmi maa yahwiihi maswaa yaa
najjaytanii amsi min hawdii ilaa silahin
fal yawma kun lii wa hazzim minka jadwaa yaa
antal hafiizul lazii abghii himaayatahu
fakun hafiizii wa zid yaa rabbi taqwaa yaa
lakan siraa fiya kasban qudzimaamiya yaa
rabbi wa hab liya hamdan rabbi masraa yaa
lakartihaa liya zaa jar-yin fasuq gharadii
liya haajilan aa-iban wal tahmi majraa yaa
hab lii bikawnika wahhaabaa bilaa sababin
maa faaqa zanniya wamlaa rabbi mahdaa yaa
qud zaa bilutqin wa juudin wakfinii zalalan
lakan tihaa-ii ilaahii minka mabdaa yaa
wajjahtu fis sabti wajhii laka fii rajabin
wa fis sulaasaa-i fii shahbaana maljaa yaa
yaa rabbi salli bitasliimin halaa sanadii
muhammadin wa bihi qudnii li-arjaa yaa
yaa rabbi salli bitasliimin halayhi bilaa
haddin mahal aali wal as-haabi manjaa yaa
halayhi salli wa sallim bil jamiihi wa kun
munawwiraa biya azmaanii wa anjaa yaa
zidnii huluuman bikashqin laa yufaariqunii
yaa man lahu ashtakii waltushki shakwaa yaa
yaa khayra mughnin qadaa haajii bilaa kulafin
yaa man bikawnika lii faaraqtu balwaa yaa
zintul qasaa-ida fiykum shaakiran lakumu
bihaa bikum waajahuu lil kashfa wal aayaa
